name: Steak Coconut Curry with Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Cilantro & Lime

instructions.primary_message: Place spices in a large bowl and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp garam masala
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and thinly slice across the grain. Add to the bowl with the spices and toss to coat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and pan-fry until almost cooked through, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 red bell peppers
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the ginger.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return pot to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, chili-garlic sauce, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut milk and stir to combine the curry. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 5-6 minutes more.
Meanwhile, cut limes into wedges. Set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the curry has thickened, return steak to the pot, along with half of the cilantro, and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until steak is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Divide steak curry between plates or bowls and top with remaining cilantro. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
